# Copper

![Copper](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/copper.png)

Funds your next move.

- **Rarity:** Common
- **Heads chance:** 30%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Gain 2 gold

## Tails
Gain 1 energy

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Trader](characters-trader)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** none
